title.how: A <title> written in <svelte:head> on each page, as the SEO docs advise; the starter has none.
title.note: <svelte:head> is Svelte's general head element, nothing specific to titles.

contentInHtml.how: Every page is server-rendered by default.

skipLink.how: Written by hand in the layout.

csp.how: The csp option emits the policy, with nonces or hashes for SvelteKit's own scripts and styles.
csp.note: Off unless configured; a header on dynamic pages, a meta tag on prerendered ones.

frameOptions.how: frame-ancestors in the csp option's directives.
frameOptions.note: Only where the policy goes out as a header; a prerendered page's meta tag cannot carry it.

robots.note: From the template, not the framework.

sitemap.how: A sitemap.xml/+server.js endpoint that writes the XML by hand, as the SEO docs show.
